system.description:
Range 60ft; up to 10ft of wood per level (a door, plank, wooden weapon or shield). Doors jam shut or swing open; a held wooden weapon or shield is useless unless its holder passes a Reflex save. Cast reversed (Straighten Wood), warped wood is restored and Warp Wood on it ends.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Druid
system.saveEffect: A held wooden weapon or shield still works
